mutations.name: updateEnterpriseCopilotCodeReviewPolicy
mutations.description: Updates an enterprise's Copilot code review policy using the existing policy propagation and notification behavior.

returnFields.name: clientMutationId
returnFields.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation.

mutations.name: updateOrganizationCopilotCodeReviewPolicy
mutations.description: Updates an organization's Copilot code review policy when the enterprise delegates control to organization administrators.

returnFields.name: clientMutationId
returnFields.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation.

returnFields.name: conflict
returnFields.description: Why the policy was not updated. Null if the update succeeded.

mutations.name: updateOrganizationCopilotCodeReviewRunnerConfiguration
mutations.description: Sets the runner configuration that Copilot code review uses for an organization. A LABELED runner requires at least one label or a runner group. Invalid input does not change the configuration.

returnFields.name: clientMutationId
returnFields.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation.

mutations.name: updateOrganizationCopilotCodeReviewSettings
mutations.description: Updates an organization's Copilot code review settings. Omitted settings are not changed.

returnFields.name: clientMutationId
returnFields.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation.

returnFields.name: conflict
returnFields.description: Why the settings were not updated. Null if the update succeeded.

mutations.name: updateRepositoryCopilotCodeReviewSettings
mutations.description: Updates a repository's Copilot code review settings. Omitted settings are not changed.

returnFields.name: clientMutationId
returnFields.description: A unique identifier for the client performing the mutation.

fields.name: api
fields.description: Copilot API endpoint.

fields.name: exp
fields.description: Copilot experimentation (edge TAS) endpoint.

fields.name: originTracker
fields.description: Copilot origin tracker endpoint.

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: Copilot proxy endpoint.

fields.name: telemetry
fields.description: Copilot telemetry endpoint.

objects.name: EnterpriseCopilotCodeReviewPolicy
objects.description: The enterprise's configured Copilot code review policy, not a user's effective policy.

fields.name: policyState
fields.description: The configured policy. Null if the enterprise has not configured a policy.

objects.name: OrganizationCopilotCodeReviewDefaultEffort
objects.description: An organization's default Copilot code review effort.

fields.name: configured
fields.description: The effort stored for the organization. Null if the organization inherits the default or has stored an effort that is not currently available.

fields.name: editable
fields.description: Whether organization administrators can update the setting.

fields.name: effective
fields.description: The effort that repositories without their own setting use. When that effort is not currently available, this reports the fallback effort instead.

fields.name: githubDefault
fields.description: The effort the organization inherits when it does not configure one: the enterprise default when one applies, otherwise GitHub's default.

fields.name: managedBy
fields.description: Whether the enterprise or the organization controls the setting.

objects.name: OrganizationCopilotCodeReviewPolicy
objects.description: The organization's configured and effective Copilot code review policy.

fields.name: configuredState
fields.description: The policy stored for the organization. Null if the organization has not configured a policy.

fields.name: editable
fields.description: Whether organization administrators can update the policy.

fields.name: effectiveState
fields.description: The policy that applies to the organization after enterprise policy is considered.

fields.name: managedBy
fields.description: Whether the enterprise or the organization controls the policy.

objects.name: OrganizationCopilotCodeReviewRunnerConfiguration
objects.description: The effective runner configuration that Copilot code review uses for an organization.

fields.name: allowRepositoryCustomization
fields.description: Whether repositories can use their own runner configuration.

fields.name: configuredBy
fields.description: Which configuration the values come from. CODING_AGENT means they are inherited from the organization's Copilot coding agent runner configuration.

fields.name: runnerGroupName
fields.description: The runner group used for a labeled runner, if any.

fields.name: runnerLabels
fields.description: The runner labels used for a labeled runner.

fields.name: runnerType
fields.description: The type of runner.

fields.name: availableReviewEfforts
fields.description: The review efforts that can currently be set for this organization, in display order.

fields.name: defaultReviewEffort
fields.description: The default review effort for repositories that do not choose their own.

fields.name: configured
fields.description: The effort stored for the repository. Null if the repository inherits its effort or has stored an effort that is not currently available.

fields.name: effective
fields.description: The effort reviews use when the requester and the pull request do not choose one. When that effort is not currently available, this reports the effort reviews would use without it.

objects.name: RepositoryCopilotCodeReviewSettings
objects.description: A repository's Copilot code review settings. These settings tune reviews; they do not enable Copilot code review.

fields.name: availableReviewEfforts
fields.description: The review efforts that can currently be set for this repository, in display order.

fields.name: customInstructionsEnabled
fields.description: Whether reviews use the repository's custom instructions.

fields.name: mcpEnabled
fields.description: Whether reviews can use MCP servers.

fields.name: reviewEffort
fields.description: The repository's review effort.

fields.name: severityFilter
fields.description: Which review comment severities Copilot code review leaves out.

interfaces.name: Agentic
interfaces.description: Copilot Agentic fields in context of the current viewer.

fields.name: viewerCopilotAgentCreatesChannel
fields.description: Channel value for subscribing to live updates for session creations.

fields.name: viewerCopilotAgentLogUpdatesChannel
fields.description: Channel value for subscribing to live updates for session log updates.

fields.name: viewerCopilotAgentTaskUpdatesChannel
fields.description: Channel value for subscribing to live updates for task updates.

fields.name: viewerCopilotAgentUpdatesChannel
fields.description: Channel value for subscribing to live updates for session updates.

enums.name: CopilotCodeReviewEffort
enums.description: The effort level for a Copilot code review. For more information, see Review effort level.

values.name: BALANCED
values.description: Balanced effort and depth.

values.name: DYNAMIC
values.description: Copilot picks the effort for each pull request.

values.name: LITE
values.description: Lower effort, faster review.

values.name: MAX
values.description: Highest effort, deepest review.

enums.name: CopilotCodeReviewEffortLevel
enums.description: A Copilot code review effort level. For more information, see Review effort level.

values.name: BALANCED
values.description: Balanced effort and depth.

values.name: DYNAMIC
values.description: Copilot picks the effort for each pull request.

values.name: LITE
values.description: Lower effort, faster review.

values.name: MAX
values.description: Highest effort, deepest review.

enums.name: CopilotCodeReviewRequestReason
enums.description: The stable reason a Copilot code review request was denied or conflicted with an existing request.

values.name: ACTOR_INELIGIBLE
values.description: The actor is not eligible to request Copilot code reviews.

values.name: APP_NOT_INSTALLED
values.description: The Copilot code review reviewer app is not installed.

values.name: LICENSED_ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE
values.description: The organization providing the Copilot license is unavailable.

values.name: NO_QUOTA_REMAINING
values.description: The actor has no Copilot code review quota remaining.

values.name: REPOSITORY_INELIGIBLE
values.description: The repository is not eligible for Copilot code reviews.

values.name: REQUEST_CONFLICT
values.description: A Copilot code review request is already pending for this pull request.

enums.name: CopilotCodeReviewRunnerConfiguredBy
enums.description: Which configuration an organization's Copilot code review runner values come from.

values.name: CODE_REVIEW
values.description: The organization has saved a Copilot code review runner configuration.

values.name: CODING_AGENT
values.description: The values are inherited from the organization's Copilot coding agent runner configuration.

enums.name: CopilotCodeReviewRunnerType
enums.description: The type of runner Copilot code review uses.

values.name: LABELED
values.description: Runners that match the configured labels or runner group.

values.name: STANDARD
values.description: Standard GitHub-hosted runners.

enums.name: CopilotCodeReviewSeverityFilter
enums.description: Which review comment severities Copilot code review leaves out.

values.name: LOW
values.description: Leave out low-severity comments.

values.name: LOW_AND_MEDIUM
values.description: Leave out low- and medium-severity comments.

values.name: NO_FILTER
values.description: Keep every comment.

enums.name: EnterpriseCopilotCodeReviewPolicyState
enums.description: The configured Copilot code review policy for an enterprise.

values.name: CONFIGURED_BY_ORGANIZATION_ADMINS
values.description: Organization administrators configure Copilot code review. Not supported for standalone enterprises.

values.name: DISABLED_FOR_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS
values.description: Copilot code review is disabled for all organizations.

values.name: ENABLED_FOR_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS
values.description: Copilot code review is enabled for all organizations.

enums.name: OrganizationCopilotCodeReviewEffortSetting
enums.description: The default Copilot code review effort to set for an organization. For more information, see Review effort level.

values.name: BALANCED
values.description: Balanced effort and depth.

values.name: DYNAMIC
values.description: Copilot picks the effort for each pull request.

values.name: INHERIT
values.description: Clear the organization's value so repositories inherit the default.

values.name: LITE
values.description: Lower effort, faster review.

values.name: MAX
values.description: Highest effort, deepest review.

enums.name: OrganizationCopilotCodeReviewPolicyConflict
enums.description: Why an organization's Copilot code review policy was not updated.

values.name: POLICY_MANAGED_BY_ENTERPRISE
values.description: The enterprise policy controls the organization's policy.

enums.name: OrganizationCopilotCodeReviewPolicyManager
enums.description: The scope that controls an organization's Copilot code review policy.

values.name: ENTERPRISE
values.description: The enterprise policy controls the organization's policy.

values.name: ORGANIZATION

enums.name: OrganizationCopilotCodeReviewPolicyState

values.name: DISABLED

values.name: ENABLED

enums.name: RepositoryCopilotCodeReviewEffortSetting
enums.description: The Copilot code review effort to set for a repository. For more information, see Review effort level.
